technical.summary: LMT shows strong structural bullish alignment with price above all major MAs and new highs, but overbought oscillators (RSI-9, Stoch-K, Williams-R) and weak ADX trend confirmation limit swing entry probability; better suited for pullback entry or confirmation of momentum continuation.

fundamental.summary: LMT shows no actionable smart money signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, absent government contract visibility, and earnings arriving in 42 days creating elevated event risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (11/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity; weak congressional buying (small amounts, junior members) offers minimal conviction support; no recent news data to confirm setup.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (346.7) combined with flat yield curve and 42-day earnings event creates highly unfavourable macro backdrop for LMT trading.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price above all major moving averages with supertrend bullish and new 20-day highs provides structural upside bias, supported by extreme fear sentiment creating contrarian opportunity.
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought oscillators (RSI-9: 74.51, Stoch-K: 84.77), weak ADX trend confirmation (11.64), VIX crisis regime (346.7), 42-day earnings event risk, and zero fundamental/smart money support make immediate entry high-probability mean reversion setup.

decision.entry_rationale: Already holding LMT with 73 existing Industrials positions creates dangerous concentration risk; overbought technicals (RSI 74.51, Stoch-K 84.77) at resistance with weak ADX trend confirmation signal mean-reversion probability.
decision.primary_risk: VIX crisis regime (346.7) combined with 42-day earnings event and overbought oscillators creates high probability of sharp pullback or gap move that could trigger stop-loss cascade across portfolio.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on unfavourable risk/reward; technical, fundamental, sentiment, and risk all point to avoidance
decision.portfolio_note: Existing LMT position + 73 Industrials holdings (18% of 403 total positions) creates unacceptable sector concentration; macro environment (VIX 346.7, flat yield curve) argues for de-risking, not adding exposure.
